$comment: CAMEO event codes we treat as conflict activity, mapped to IGRED categories. Severity is an ordinal display weight (1-5), not a casualty estimate. Codes outside this map are discarded.
$relevanceComment: A conflict-coded record is not automatically a conflict event — the raw feed is full of ordinary crime. Two gates were tested against live data and rejected: corroboration count (US police shootings clear it easily) and CAMEO actor-type codes (they are assigned by word matching, so an article about a strike yields actor type REB via the word 'rebellion'). What remains is the verified register: an event displays if the conflict register lists its country as actively at war. New conflicts reach the register through detection and human confirmation, not through guessing. Detection itself runs ungated.
